product: UK winter wheat — in-season area & yield forecast

value_encoding.format: uint32 n, uint8[n] wheat, uint8[n] yield

admin_note: Area basis: deduplicated 5 m map, wheat hectares per cell. Levels reconcile with the Great Britain headline.

field_validation.note: bias is reported, not applied; interval stays calibrated to the yield model target (field check nearest at DOY182)

market_value.note: harvest-delivery futures marker; ex-farm realisations differ by basis. Market band = price x horizon vol (lognormal approx, independence of GB crop size and world price assumed).

Produced by UCL and the National Centre for Earth Observation (NCEO), with the UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology (UKCEH), as part of the AgZero+ project.

Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel-2 data (2019–2026). Field boundaries derived from Sentinel-2; administrative boundaries © Office for National Statistics (Open Government Licence v3.0). area_uncertainty.source: Olofsson accuracy assessment of the 2025 hindcast, production configuration (5 m segref arm): 50,009 reference points, wheat UA 0.939 / PA 0.908, ci95 18,441 ha on 1,549,956 ha adjusted
area_uncertainty.note: Published at the product-wide 90% level (ci95 x 1.645/1.96). The same assessment measures an omission-led adjustment factor of +6.3% which is disclosed, not applied: the published area remains a direct pixel count of the map. Transfer assumes 2025-measured accuracy carries to 2026.
